title: Close the initiative separately from ending a session
when: When linked work is nearly complete or the user asks whether the initiative can be archived.
need: Audit delivered scope, evidence and tracked deferrals before archiving an initiative. A session wrapup or steering-seat release answers a different question.
surface: Steer close-out step 4 (Close-out note, State delivered, ask, archive); Wrapup
gap: Steer close-out teaches the archive step once every linked item is done. Open: whether a scope, evidence and deferral audit should precede it, and how it coexists with Blitz automatically archiving its execution document on successful done.
